[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Chipotle BBQ Sauce: 1 cup ketchup, 1/2 cup chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, 1/4 cup brown sugar, 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, salt and pepper to taste.
